newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES SLIGHTLY UP.
newsitem.headline: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES SLIGHTLY UP.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly up in a more active trade on the first market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 472.94 from 472.74 on Tuesday.
Volume was 2.75 million dinars against 5.39 million dinars. Trade on the first market was active with 49,000 shares changing hands.
Coke and beer bottler SFBT gained 2.28 dinars to 78.76 dinars. Tunisie Leasing rose 0.68 dinar to 29 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat was down 1.19 dinar to 18.8 dinars. BNA bank fell 0.95 dinar to 30.86 dinars with 32,129 shares exchanged. Detergents firm SPCD eased 0.5 dinar to 25.08 dinars. ($= 1.04 dinars)
